sections.html: This fish occurs in the Orinoco basin in Venezuela and in the upper Rio Negro in Brazil. The specimens offered, imported for the first time ever, come from Venezuela.

Once the genus Rivulus was one of the most speciose genera of killifish. Nowadays, more and more species are placed in different, smaller genera. This splitting is not always supported by the majority of scientists, so some of them still call all species Rivulus, while others follow the splitting. If the splitting is justified, tecminae is placed in the genus Laimosemion.
